### Pick a provider

Codes go **by SMS** (`sms_config.channel = 'sms'`, the default). SMS reaches
every phone and iOS fills the code in by itself.

| `SMS_PROVIDER` | Secrets | Price per code (France) |
|---|---|---|
| `brevo` (recommended) | `BREVO_API_KEY`, `BREVO_SENDER` (max 11 characters, e.g. `TRINITY`) | ≈ €0.045, less in larger packs |
| `twilio` | `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID`, `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN`, `TWILIO_FROM` | ≈ €0.07 |

WhatsApp (≈ €0.035 a code) is built in but off. To use it: a WhatsApp
Business sender on Twilio, an approved *authentication* template whose `{{1}}`
is the code, the secrets `TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM` and
`TWILIO_WHATSAPP_CONTENT_SID`, then `update sms_config set channel = 'whatsapp';`.
A number WhatsApp refuses then gets the code by SMS automatically.

WhatsApp (≈ €0.035 a code) is built in but off. To use it: a WhatsApp
Business sender on Twilio, an approved *authentication* template whose `{{1}}`
is the code, the secrets `TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM` and
`TWILIO_WHATSAPP_CONTENT_SID`, then `update sms_config set channel = 'whatsapp';`.
A number WhatsApp refuses then gets the code by SMS automatically.

every phone and iOS fills the code in by itself.
